# Ridu 0.11.2

This patch treats a migration that is not needed as a successful CLI outcome.

## Fixes

- `ridu migrate create` now exits successfully when the schema is unchanged or only admin
  presentation settings changed. It prints `No migration needed` with the reason and writes
  no artifact. Genuine planning, validation, and safety failures still return an error.
- `ridu upgrade` recognizes this successful no-op and does not report that a migration was
  created. New migrations still print their creation details and require the ordinary review
  and application workflow.
- PostgreSQL, SQLite, and MongoDB migration planning and development rename handling now use
  typed current-schema outcomes rather than matching error text.

## Upgrade

Update the Go module and all Ridu npm packages to 0.11.2 together, regenerate application
contracts, and rebuild with the matching CLI. Scripts that call `ridu migrate create` should
expect exit code zero when nothing needs migrating. This patch changes no public API signatures,
manifest/protocol versions, plugin contracts, or persisted migration encodings. Keep existing
migration artifacts and database ledgers; these fixes require no new application migration.
